hero.name: Rojja Kharel
hero.headline: PROJECT MANAGEMENT · OPERATIONS · STRATEGY
hero.description: A New York-area project management professional with experience across public-sector capital projects, global programs, supply chain operations, customer success, and executive support.
hero.note: Building a career around thoughtful execution, strong stakeholder relationships, and measurable results.

about.heading: Cross-functional experience with an executive mindset.
about.text_1: Rojja brings together project coordination, operations, stakeholder management, reporting, and strategy. Her experience spans New York City infrastructure, higher education, global programming, supply chain, sales enablement, and customer success.
about.text_2: She is completing an M.S. in Project Management at New York University and holds a B.A. in International Studies from Ramapo College of New Jersey, where she graduated summa cum laude.

experience.heading: Experience across public service, education, operations, and customer success.

featured.title: Special Projects Capital Program Project Manager Intern
featured.description: Supported capital design and construction work in the NYC watershed, coordinating schedules, compliance requirements, contract-document review, and communication among project managers, engineers, contractors, and consultants.

jobs.title: Graduate Program Assistant
jobs.organization: NYU Steinhardt Office of Global Affairs
jobs.description: Supports operations and strategic management for study abroad programming across 12+ global locations, including reporting, data validation, communications, and outreach.

jobs.title: Supply Chain Analyst / Executive Assistant to the CEO
jobs.organization: AriMax Global Corporation / Matrix Analytics / Arim Inc.
jobs.description: Coordinated procurement, supplier performance, inventory strategy, executive communications, and sales campaigns while supporting the CEO and cross-functional stakeholders.

jobs.title: Customer Success Fellow
jobs.description: Improved CRM workflows, customer communication, team documentation, and special-project research focused on customer success and clean energy.

leadership.heading: Comfortable bringing people together and moving conversations forward.
leadership.text: Beyond formal roles, Rojja has grown into public-facing leadership through presenting, moderating, professional networking, and helping build professional communities. In 2026, she helped organize and host the first Tech & AI NYC networking event for Nepali Leaders Network and moderated a panel discussion.

recognition.heading: Confidence with a commitment to community.
recognition.title: Miss Community Outreach
recognition.description_1: Rojja stepped outside her comfort zone to participate in a beauty pageant experience centered on confidence, courage, grace, and personal growth.
recognition.description_2: Following an intensive week of preparation and training, she received the Miss Community Outreach award, recognizing her commitment to community, representation, and meaningful engagement with others.
